sources.title: InsideEVs: The Cadillac Escalade IQ crushed its estimated range in a 70-mph test (Moloughney, 2025-06-23)
sources.notes: 2025 Escalade IQ held a GPS-measured 70 mph on the NJ Turnpike: 482.2 mi on one charge, 222.7 kWh used in total (214.9 kWh driving + 7.8 kWh climate and charge prep), cabin 70 F low fan, ambient rising into the 80s F. Trim and wheels not stated.

sources.title: Cars.com: 2025 Cadillac Escalade IQ starts at $129,990
sources.notes: 11.5 kW onboard charger standard on Luxury 1 and Sport 1; the 2 trims add the 19.2 kW charger.

sources.title: Cars.com: All-electric 2026 Cadillac Escalade IQL
sources.notes: IQL: 11.5 kW onboard charger standard, 19.2 kW optional (no trim breakdown); wheels Luxury/Sport 22 in, Premium Luxury/Premium Sport 24 in.

sources.title: Green Cars Compare: Cadillac Celestiq charging
sources.notes: Lists up to 19.2 kW AC and 190 kW DC, CCS1, 400 V, "116.8 kWh battery (111 kWh usable)". Spec site; does not name GM as the source, so the AC value is recorded as estimated. EPA/NRCan 240 V charge time 8.0 h.

sources.title: InsideEVs: 2024 GMC Sierra EV range, specs and pricing overview
sources.notes: Denali Edition 1: about 400 mi GM estimate, 24-module 200+ kWh pack, 350 kW on 800 V chargers, 19.2 kW onboard AC, 24-in wheels (later Denali 22 in; 2025 Elevation/AT4 18 in).

sources.title: InsideEVs: 2024 GMC Sierra EV Denali Edition 1 gets 440 miles of range
sources.notes: GM updated estimate: up to 440 mi; up to 350 kW, about 100 mi in 10 min; 19.2 kW onboard AC; pack kWh not stated, "likely the same 800 V 24-module pack" as Hummer/Silverado.

sources.title: Green Car Reports: 2025 GMC Sierra EV test drive review
sources.notes: Denali Max Range 2025: GM-estimated 460 mi (heavy truck, no EPA rating), 205 kWh pack, 350 kW peak; Extended Range 170 kWh / 300 kW.

sources.title: InsideEVs: The GMC Sierra Denali is the new EV range king (Edmunds test)
sources.notes: Edmunds EV Range Test: 507 mi, 48.1 kWh/100 mi (2.0 mi/kWh), 60/40 city/highway mix at 40 mph average, 58 F, 24-in wheels, Denali with the 200+ kWh Max pack. Edmunds blocks fetches; read via this relay and Jalopnik.

sources.title: Jalopnik: GMC Sierra EV Denali goes 507 miles in Edmunds range test
sources.notes: Edmunds tested the Sierra EV Max Range Denali: 507 mi, 48.1 kWh/100 mi, 24-in wheels, mixed route.

sources.title: Motor Authority: 2022 GMC Hummer EV price, specs, review
sources.notes: 2022 Hummer EV Edition 1 per GM: 205 kWh usable (IEC 62660) / 213 kWh (ISO 12405); 400 V packs in parallel or 800 V in series; 350 kW DC CCS; 11.5 kW Level 2 onboard; 329 mi; 18-in wheels.

sources.title: Motor Authority: 2022 Hummer EV Edition 1 has 329 miles of range, too heavy for EPA rating
sources.notes: GM confirmed 329 mi; not EPA rated (GVWR 10,400 lb); 200 kWh pack.

sources.title: KBB: Hummer EV gets new trim levels, 355-mile range
sources.notes: 2023 pickup: Edition 1 329 mi; EV3X 22-in wheels 355 mi (8,500 lb tow) or 329 mi with Extreme Off-Road package.

sources.title: InsideEVs: 2024 GMC Hummer EV gets bidirectional charging
sources.notes: "The previous model year Hummers came with a standard 11.5 kW AC onboard charger"; 2024 adds a 19.2 kW Level 2 onboard charger as standard on SUV Edition 1/3X/2X and pickup 3X/2X.

sources.title: InsideEVs: Hummer EV range test (70 mph)
sources.notes: 2022 Hummer EV Pickup Edition 1, constant 70 mph on I-94 Michigan, 343 mi, 1.6 mi/kWh (38.75 kWh/100 km), 70-78 F, 10 mph wind, climate 68-70 F lowest fan, Normal mode, 212.7 kWh usable pack, 9,063 lb.

sources.title: Cars.com: 2025 Cadillac Lyriq specs (Luxury w/1SC)
sources.notes: Only the Luxury w/1SC is detailed: 20-in aluminium wheels, 265/50R20 tires.

sources.title: Electric Autonomy: GMC announces Canadian pricing of Sierra EV Denali pickup truck (2024-10-16)
sources.notes: 2025 Sierra EV Denali arriving at Canadian dealers in two versions: Extended Range (628 km) and Max Range ($119,699 MSRP, "an extended 740 km"). Range stated for Max Range without saying whether it is a GM estimate.

sources.title: Canada Drives: 2023 GMC Hummer EV Pickup first drive review
sources.notes: Edition 1 pickup: Canadian pricing "closer to the Hummer's arrival in Canada, slated for December 2022"; "530 kilometres of range". Does not confirm a Canadian sale date or a final price.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Measured by Tom Moloughney on a 2025 Escalade IQ, constant GPS-measured 70 mph on the NJ Turnpike, 482.2 mi, 222.7 kWh drawn in total (214.9 kWh driving only = 277 Wh/km), cabin about 70 F, ambient rising into the 80s F, about 8 h. 222.7/482.2 = 46.2 kWh/100 mi x 10/1.609344 = 287 Wh/km. Independent test, not a maker or regulator rating (B97). Energy basis: not stated by the page; 222.7 kWh is above the roughly 205 kWh pack, so it probably includes charging losses or climate/prep draw, i.e. nearer wall-to-wheels than pack-side. 2025 only (not carried to other model years).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: NRCan 2025 "Sierra EV Extended Range" shows a 240 V charge time of 11.5 h and EPA 2025 the same, identical to the Silverado EV rows labelled "19.2 kW Charger" (same truck and pack; the 11.5 kW rows take 18.6 h). 2026 Sierra Denali has both options.

Estimated: Green Cars Compare (spec site, does not name GM) says "up to 19.2 kW AC", 111 kWh usable (116.8 gross); NRCan/EPA 240 V charge time 8.0 h agrees: 108.8 kWh (repo usable estimate) / 8.0 h = 13.6 kW into the pack, 111 / 8.0 = 13.9 kW, about 71-72% of 19.2 kW, similar to the 19.2 kW Lyriq (100 kWh / 7.0 h = 14.3 kW). An 11.5 kW car would need about 11 h. Replaces the 11.5 kW estimate.

NRCan 2025: "Silverado EV LT/RST Ext Range (19.2 kW Charger)", 240 V charge time 11.5 h.

Estimated: NRCan 2023 "LYRIQ" and EPA 2023 LYRIQ list one 240 V charge time of 6.5 h, which matches the 19.2 kW car (2025 LYRIQ 19.2 kW: 7.0 h; 11.5 kW: 11.2 h; 2023 AWD, 10.7 h, is the 11.5 kW car). 100 kWh / 6.5 h is about 15 kW into the pack, not possible on 11.5 kW. Basis: same hardware in another model year, years compared 2023 and 2025. Replaces the repo 11.5 kW estimate. 2023 AWD stays 11.5 kW (10.7 h).

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Motor Authority, per GM: 205 kWh usable (IEC 62660), 213 kWh (ISO 12405). GM TechLink says "approximately 200 kWh available" (used on the 2024 3X record).

battery.chemistry.notes: Estimated: same 24-module Ultium NCMA pouch cells as the 2024 3X record (Weekly Driver); closest enum nmc.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: GM TechLink (2022-04-14): about 400 V per layer, series for "800-volt DC fast charging". Treated as 800v like the 2024 records.

battery.preconditioning.notes: GM TechLink (2022-04-14): "apps can precondition the battery". No automatic navigation trigger is documented for the 2022 truck on any page opened (the GM preconditioning guide returns 403), so manual_only; the 2024 3X record may differ.

dc_max_kw.notes: Motor Authority, per GM: 350 kW CCS; TechLink: up to 800 V/350 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs: "previous model year Hummers came with a standard 11.5 kW AC onboard charger" (19.2 kW starts 2024); Motor Authority 2022: 11.5 kW Level 2. Differs from the 2024 powertrains (19.2 kW).

charge_port.notes: Motor Authority: 350 kW CCS (North America: CCS1).

supercharger_access.notes: US: GM-approved NACS adapter; GMC Hummer EV is on InsideEVs 2026 Supercharger-access list. Current state for a 2022-23 owner.

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: GM has not published the Sierra EV Edition 1 capacity. Same-truck basis: the Silverado EV Max Range 24-module pack is recorded in the repo at 204 kWh usable (InsideEVs); InsideEVs says the Sierra EV Edition 1 is "likely the same 800-volt, 24-module pack". Green Car Reports gives "205 kWh pack" for the 2025 Sierra Max Range without saying usable or gross, so it is not used as usable. The Hummer 3X (200 kWh) is not used: it has three motors, the Edition 1 two.

battery.chemistry.notes: Estimated: 24-module Ultium truck pack (NCMA pouch cells) per Weekly Driver; closest enum nmc.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: InsideEVs: 800 V DC fast charging at up to 350 kW (pack about 400 V per layer, series for 800 V charging).

battery.preconditioning.notes: Estimated: lineup-wide GM guide (automatic with Google navigation plus manual app prep); GM sites return 403 (search excerpt). Caution: the guide was never readable; the nav trigger for a 2024 Sierra EV is not shown on any page opened.
